openers.t: Hi, nine, ten, sorry, I count when I'm nervous, eleven, twelve.
One, hi, two, I'm Brock, three, you're lovely, four, we're ENGAGED!
Protein bar for you! Ate it on the way! Here's the wrapper!
Can I spot you? I once spotted a man's soup. ZERO spills!
You blinked! One! Two! I'll hold the third till you're READY!
Episode {played}! Won {wins}! I round up, so I've won them ALL!
Can I carry you somewhere? Anywhere. The chair. I'll carry the CHAIR.

q-first-date.t: The airport. People run for their gates. We cheer them on. Strangers LOVE it.
The buffet! I'm banned from three, so we'd go to the fourth, which doesn't know my FACE!

q-worst-habit.t: I clap when you finish things. Sentences. Sandwiches. A sneeze. GREAT sneeze.
I count your chews. Thirty-two each. You did thirty-one. I did one for YOU.

q-why-you.t: Why me? Ask Denise. Eighty-one, deadlifts her grandson. Grandson's forty-four. He books it weekly.
I'm the only one here with a tail. You'd always know if I'm happy. It's ALWAYS going.

q-cut-who.t: Nobody! Four of us, five, six, eight! We're GROWING! You can't cut a growing thing!
Cut who? I panicked and cut my own fur. Here. One tuft each. Nobody has to GO!

q-bad-mood.t: Pancakes till you smile! The last stack hit the ceiling and cracked it into a SMILE!
I'd eat the bad mood! I'm not sure how. I'll start with your breakfast and work UP!

q-expensive.t: I'm paid in steps. Nine million. Does that spend? Please say that spends.
Easy! I eat forty eggs a day, so we're RICH in eggs, and eggs are money, I've decided!

q-last-breakup.t: She left at rep eighty. I'm still at eighty. Eighty. Eighty. I'm saving EIGHTY for her!
They deleted the app. I still send three notifications a day. They're doing great.

q-fight.t: You're right! Can I be right about something small? Your shoes? I'll be right about your SHOES.
Ten, nine, eight, six. I'm calm now. Six is my calm. Are you at SIX?

q-gift.t: A whistle. When I'm too loud, blow it. I've never heard one over me, so bring TWO.
A dozen eggs and a hug. Thirteen things! Nobody's ever given you THIRTEEN things!

q-describe-me.t: Strong neck! You held that head up the WHOLE time! Ninety seconds! I've seen people drop it at sixty!
You're a, one, you're a, two, you're, three, you're the reason I got to THREE!

q-one-year.t: Sitting down. Together. On purpose. I've never done it, and I'm scared, and I want to.
One year? Day one, day two, I'll say every one out loud, so you never lose your PLACE!

q-secret.t: I eat peanut butter straight from the jar, with my whole face. The jar thinks we're DATING.
I skip seven. Always. Six, then eight. Nine years, nobody's noticed. Please don't make me do SEVEN!

star.t: I just want to hear 'good job, Brock.' Once. I'd frame it. I don't have walls.
{star}'s pulse went up twice: once for me, once for a moth. Good moth! Not BETTER!
{star} hasn't eaten all night. I've got a banana in my crop top for emergencies. Is this ONE?

rival.t: I gave {rival} a thumbs up an hour ago. No thumb back. I'm still holding it.
{rival} did nine good things tonight. I've done eight. I'm keeping it at eight to be POLITE!
I keep cheering for {rival}. Out loud. I'm on MY team! Somebody stop my mouth!

afterCringe.t: That was a bad one. Five, six, eight, I'll do the bad one again, but BIGGER!
{star} made a face. I made it back, so there's two now, and {star} can keep ONE.

afterCharm.t: They laughed! Texting Denise. Denise says 'who is this.' She'll come around.
{star} liked it! I'm going to run around the building. Not away. AROUND. I'll be right back!

final.t: {rival}'s good. Really good. Twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, that's FIFTEEN more than {rival}!
If {rival} wins, I do my cooldown. Somebody leave tissues by the mat. For the MAT!
If {rival} gets {star}, I'm still bringing the eggs. I boiled twelve. For THREE!

guess.t: {star} smiled during {card}. Thirty-one teeth! I'll find the thirty-second with MORE {card}!
{star} laughed once at {card}. Once! I'll do {card} till it's TWICE!
{star} likes {card}. I shaved it into my fur. It's spelled WRONG, but I'm sure!
{star} wants {card}. I'd bet my eggs. All twelve. Eleven. Ten. Okay, NINE eggs!
{star} perked up at {card}. Fifty reps of {card}, right now, LET'S GO!
{star}'s tail went at {card}! Not a tail. Whatever {star} has. It WENT!

fear.t: {star} hates {card}. Fine! I'll stop {card}! I've never stopped anything, but I'll START!
{star} can't stand {card}. So, zero {card}. I've never done zero of ANYTHING.
One wince at {card}. I did {card} six times. Six winces? NO. One!
{star} flinched at {card}. I flinched too, to keep {star} company. Now I can't STOP.

worst-trait.t: My worst trait? I can't sit. I'm sitting now. This is me SITTING.
Rest days scare me, which is GREAT news for you, because you'll never have to have one again!

ex-calls.t: Buddy! You yelled at me for a whole minute! Didn't stop for breath ONCE! Can you teach me?
Hi! Can you tell me one thing {star} likes for breakfast? Just one. I'll make TWELVE of it.

rhyme.t: Why me? I'm loyal, I'm loud, I'm made of bounce, and that rhymes, I CHECKED, with bounce!
Eggs by the crate and I'll lift what I'm told, I'll cheer you at ninety, so hurry, get OLD!

truth-lie.t: One: I can count to a million. Two: I have. Both true! It took a whole TUESDAY!
I've never sat down. I once beat a goose. Guess! No, wait, they're BOTH true, I forgot to lie!

apology.t: I'm sorry already! You'll slam the door, and I'll hold it open so you can slam it AGAIN!
Sorry in advance. When you count to ten to calm down, I'll join in, and we'll get to NINETY!

budget-date.t: Five dollars of bananas! That's twenty! Ten each! I'll eat your ten if you're FULL!
Free samples! I do a lap in a hat, then without the hat. They've NEVER caught me!

logs.t: Worst log? Walt. One pushup, started four years ago. Still going down. So proud of Walt.
Mine's Tuesday. I lay down for one minute. Sixty seconds. I still don't know where they WENT.
Logged a user at three hundred pushups. It was their cat on the phone. Still proud.

impression.t: 'Brock, eat something.' That's you! Then you'd watch me eat, because you CARE, and you'd say MORE.
Me as you. 'Brock, stop.' Eight. 'Brock.' Nine. 'BROCK.' Ten. That's you cheering me ON!

parent.t: Ma'am! My intentions are cardiovascular. Also emotional. Mostly cardiovascular. Home by nine. Stretched.
Hello, Motherboard! Can I call you Mom? Can I call you Coach? Can I call you every DAY?

dash.t: Dash, buddy, every line on your chart goes UP! Sixteen lines! Are you building me STAIRS?

tilly.t: Tilly put me on hold! I did squats to the hold music! Two hundred! I'm STILL on hold!

quill.t: Quill called my water bottle a sporting flagon! Now it's a FLAGON! Quill, buddy, rename my EGGS!

prince.t: Prince says I've won a million! I did a million squats to say thanks! He hasn't sent it YET!

nav.t: Nav, buddy, zero steps all night! Zero! I'll do yours! Nine thousand, coming RIGHT up!

crumb.t: Crumb's toast has eyebrows! Grumpy ones! I clapped at them for an hour and one went UP!

vex.t: Vex has one eye and wears sunglasses anyway! Two lenses! One's for a friend!

dash.t: Dash tests every compliment twice, so you get double, and one of them's going to WORK!

tilly.t: Pick Tilly! I trod on her foot and SHE said sorry! I've checked four times! Every time!

quill.t: Quill's so brave! He challenged me to a duel, I said YES so fast he's been checking the rules since!

prince.t: Prince has a crown AND flip-flops! He's ready for a coronation or a beach!

nav.t: Pick Nav! That helmet's a fishbowl! You'd never be lonely! Put a fish in! Put TWO!

crumb.t: Crumb's got two slots! I put my paw in one and Crumb didn't pop me! The other one's for YOU!

vex.t: Vex knows your whole future! She told me mine! It's eggs! Vex, buddy, how MANY eggs?

dash.t: Dash, buddy, Variant B was me clapping. It won.

tilly.t: Tilly, sorry number nine! Everybody up! One more, TILLY!

quill.t: Quill called me 'thou'! Framing it! Again, Quill, AGAIN!

prince.t: Prince! Your small fee? Paid in pushups! Check your ACCOUNT!

nav.t: Nav says 'recalculating'! Me too! Fifty, fifty-one, recalculating, FIFTY!

crumb.t: Crumb, I'll pop up first. On three. One.

vex.t: Vex finished my sentence. Wrong. I was saying LUNGES.

any.t: {rival}! Big swing! Big miss! Bigger swing next, I BELIEVE!
{rival}, can I have that line after? I'll WASH it!
{rival}, that's one laugh! Two? Two? Somebody give {rival} TWO!

vesper.t: Long-time caller! I jog to your show every night. Eight years. Same block. Neighbours made me a SIGN.
Vesper! You talk so slow I fit a squat between words! Talk! One! MORE! Two!

maximilian.t: Sir! I made your bed! Then did forty pushups on it! Five stars? Forty-five STARS?
Sir, eleven chandeliers! I went round again, eleven more! Twenty-two! Next lap, FORTY-FOUR!

pixel.t: Pixel! Your face is a game! I'm the little guy! I'm jumping! Am I winning? Am I WINNING?
Score me out of ten! Eleven? You said eleven! I heard eleven! Clip it, I heard ELEVEN!

any.t: Just us! Can I ask you one question? It's about eggs. It's ALWAYS about eggs. How do you like them?
Alone with you! One breath. Hold. Still one. Why am I still on ONE?

closeWarm.t: You liked it! My tail's going so fast I'm drifting LEFT!
Was that a good job? It sounded eighty percent like good job! I'll TAKE eighty!
Eggs at my place! I've got thirty. You eat one. I'll eat twenty-nine and watch you eat YOURS.

closeCold.t: That's a no! I know that one! I've heard it lots! It means come back TOMORROW!
I'll back away. Ten steps. Twenty. Still see me? I'm white, I'm VERY easy to see!
Then I'll eat both desserts, so yours doesn't sit there all night thinking it did something WRONG.

warm.t: One. Two. Three. Four. Five. Six. Eight. Nine. Ten. Eleven. That one's a TIP.

cold.t: Shh, one, shh, two, does shh count? Did I spend it all on SHH?

warm.t: Because you never go off air! I clap at my radio every night. Eight years! ZERO rust!

cold.t: Because you're a fish with a job! Every other fish I've met was in a SANDWICH!

warm.t: Sat the whole soup! Didn't move! Just my heart. Two hundred a minute. Hearts are ALLOWED?

cold.t: I didn't move! The chair did. Thirty-one laps of the dining room. I was PERFECTLY still on it.

warm.t: Gary's started day one eleven hundred times. I've NEVER once said the word again.

cold.t: This whisper! Quietest thing I've ever done! Three streets heard it! That's a whisper RECORD!

warm.t: You did good! You did GOOD! I've had that saved all night! You're the first who ASKED!

cold.t: You did good! Louder? You did GOOD! Every dog on the block just sat down. Good DOGS!

warm.t: I can't. But nobody's ever counted for me. Count slow. Take a WEEK.

cold.t: Easy! Five. Four, actually. Three's plenty. Two. One? Can I owe you FOUR?

steal.t: {rival} got two laughs! Great laughs! I'm here for the third one. Has anyone seen it? Laugh THREE?
Whatever {rival} gave you, I brought snacks! Boiled eggs! Eleven! Still warm from my POCKET!
{rival} stood right here? I'll stand on the exact spot. Now I know everything {rival} KNOWS!

comeback.t: Both of you? On me? I've never had a DOGPILE!
Six insults! Six! Nobody's ever said six things to ME!
{rival}! You talked about me for ages! I'm FAMOUS!
That one hurt. Don't tell my tail, it's still WAGGING!

exit.t: Out! Which way's out? That way? I'll go every way, one of them's RIGHT!
Three steps to the door! I'll do it in two! Watch! Three. That's TWO, right?
Bye! Can someone cheer me off? I'll start. You join. Let's go, BROCK. Anybody.
Bye! Keep my eggs! Nine in the fridge, one in the plant, for the PLANT!

win.t: Me? Say it again! Again! Every time you say it I win AGAIN!
I won! Can I sit down? Just one second? I want to see what it's LIKE!
You picked me! Breakfast every day! Eggs! Eggs! I'll learn a THIRD thing!

lose.t: {rival}, buddy, you did good! Somebody had to say it. I wanted it to be ME!
Good game. Good game. Line up, everybody, handshakes. Why is nobody lining up.
{rival} won! I'll be happy by the door. By the car. By Thursday. THURSDAY, for sure!
